notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only, own tab. robots.txt has a single generic 'User-agent: *' group (disallows /episerver,/App_Data,/modules,/search) and names no Claude agent. No WAF, no 403, no rate-limit at any point; ~45 same-origin fetches paced ~2s apart from the loaded page context. TREE: union of (a) the mega-menu present on every page, (b) each category page's own sibling-chip strip (plp-toggle-and-filter), and (c) sitemap.xml. The sitemap (578 URLs) contains NO /products/ category pages at all - only 378 /product/ detail pages (the whole master catalogue) plus editorial - so the nav is the tree; collecting every /products/ href seen across ~45 fetched pages gave 83 URLs and ZERO nodes beyond the mega-menu set, i.e. no hidden branch. Furniture departments: Seating, Sofas, Tables, Shelving & Storage (/products/storage/), Outdoor. QTY METHOD: each PLP embeds one JSON blob per tile in the server HTML (:data='{"type":"product","context":"plp","masterId":...}'); qty = count of distinct masterId, a structured product-ID field, not an href count. The whole grid is server-rendered - the only 'Show more +' button on these pages expands the sibling-category chip list, not the grid - so this is a complete enumeration, verified on Dining chairs where the live DOM also renders exactly 21 article.product-tile--master-product elements. COLOURWAY TRAP (as warned): the number the page prints, 'N ITEMS' in p.product-filter__count, is a finished-good/colourway count and is always >= the product count. It is computed client-side and does not exist in the SSR HTML. Corroborated on a small single-page category: Sideboards renders 3 products (Stacked Storage System Sideboard, Enfold Sideboard, Reflect Sideboard) under a '6 ITEMS' badge; Dining chairs = 21 products under '37 ITEMS'. The badge was therefore rejected and distinct products used. CROSS-PASS CHECK: this method reproduces the prior Home-Decor pass exactly on two of its published leaves - Lighting>Floor Lamps = 7 and Accessories>Vases = 4 - so Muuto's furniture rows are counted on the same basis as its rows already in the Lighting/Wall_Decor/Decorative workbooks. BAD-SLUG CHECK: /products/storage/does-not-exist-xyz/ returns 302 with no h1 and 0 tiles, so this platform does not silently serve a parent listing; every leaf below returned 200 with an h1 matching the node requested. Parent pages are curated landing grids, NOT supersets (the Seating parent shows 17 while its Dining child alone has 21), a further reason no parent total was used. MODULAR SYSTEMS: Muuto's two big named systems are reachable as real product-type nodes and are captured, not dropped - Sofas>Modular (24 modules/configurations) and Shelving & Storage>Modular Storage Systems (18: the Stacked / Mini Stacked / Compile system parts). DROPPED AS CROSS-LINKS (same products, second nav path - not padded): Seating>Sofas (21) and Seating>Outdoor (19) duplicate the Sofas and Outdoor departments; Tables>Outdoor (8) duplicates Outdoor>Tables (9); Sofas>Lounge Chairs (22) duplicates Seating>Lounge Chairs (24, kept as the department-native and larger node). DROPPED AS OUT OF SCOPE: all of Lighting (4 leaves); all of Accessories - vases, candleholders, mirrors, kitchen, hangers, rugs, cushions, throws - plus Accessories>Office (11) and Accessories>Storage (15), which title-scan as baskets, trays, toolbox, pinboard, bookend and paper bin, i.e. standalone storage goods, not furniture; Sofas>Sofa Cushions (6, textiles); Outdoor>Accessories (7: seat pads, outdoor cover, rug and two portable lamps); Extras>Components and Extras>Spare Parts (furniture parts); /products/news/, the /products/ landing page and /products/shop-by-family/* (design-line re-cut, a section-3 collection listing).
